- Stage hygiene: mark any deals that should be moved to "Commit" vs "Commit Pending" in HubSpot (link below)
- Finance blockers: flag billing/legal terms that need approvals (credit limits, SOW exceptions)
- Evidence: drop any SOC2/data-flow docs or compliance notes to the shared Drive folder

I attached a trimmed commit matrix and my runway notes. I’ll run a one‑page rollup at 16:30 PT with owners for any late escalations.
